recent.text: 🎥: https://t.co/EuSlyJfjRf Luka Doncic admitted he needed to play better and lead his team better in the Lakers’ loss to the Jazz.

recent.text: Luka Doncic called this an "unacceptable" performance from him and says he needs to lead the team better.
recent.author: Lakers Nation

recent.text: Luka Doncic says fatigue can't be an excuse and that he needed to play better.
recent.author: Lakers Nation

recent.text: Walker Kessler felt tonight's loss was more about poor shot-making than lack of effort for the Lakers. "We were playing hard. I think Vando got like three offensive rebounds on one possession. We got like five shots [on that possession] and just none of them fell."
recent.author: Lakers Nation

recent.text: Walker Kessler: "It was a tough night for me... My touch was not what it should be tonight. From the free throw line, obviously, and from the field. But you gotta figure it out and move on."
recent.author: Lakers Nation

recent.text: Walker Kessler: "It's frustrating. Tonight wasn't our night. But I think our team is gonna respond well to this loss."
recent.author: Lakers Nation

recent.text: JJ Redick admitted that Luka Doncic's workload without Austin Reaves in the lineup is "taking a toll" and has led to back-to-back inefficient nights.

recent.text: Matisse Thybulle has grabbed 3+ steals in seven-straight games, the longest such streak of his career 😎
recent.author: Los Angeles Lakers

recent.text: With his third steal tonight vs. Utah, Matisse Thybulle has recorded 3+ steals in seven consecutive games, the longest such streak of his career. Thybulle joins Eddie Jones (1996) as the only Lakers to record seven consecutive games with 3+ steals since the NBA/ABA merger
recent.author: Lakers Nation

recent.text: Not a bad 24 hours for Quentin Grimes. (via @NBA) https://t.co/nRLvDjQaJS
recent.author: Lakers Nation

recent.text: Quentin Grimes from 3, last 3 games: at PHX: 5 of 6 vs. CHA: 10 for 14 vs. UTA: 4 of 6 (midway through 3rd Q) That's a combined 19 for 26 (73.1%)
recent.author: Mike Trudell

recent.text: Quentin Grimes is doing it again. 👀 13 points in the first six minutes of the third quarter for him
recent.author: Lakers Nation

recent.text: Luka steal and finds Grimes for a dunk!
recent.author: Lakers Nation

recent.text: This is the 7th straight game for Matisse Thybulle with at least 3 steals, his latest leading to the 2nd straight 3 from Quentin Grimes, who's up to 13 points with LA grabbing a 63-62 lead. Thybulle is 2nd in the NBA in steals per game (Dyson Daniels).
recent.author: Mike Trudell

recent.text: Something to keep an eye on in the second half.

recent.quoted_text: Back-to-back games with Luka displeased with officiating. As halftime began, he tried to get an angry word with a ref. Scott Brooks got between them, and Luka kept lingering and glaring. Thybulle and Reaves unsuccessfully tried to redirect his focus. He already has a tech. AK
